name: Endeavour (STS-68)
about: Endeavour (STS-68) (1994-062A), a crewed vehicle (OV-105), launched 1994 Sep 30. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1994 Oct  2), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW22); its coordinates are written from memory
